newsitem.title: CHINA: China drafts anti-dumping laws on foreign imports.
newsitem.headline: China drafts anti-dumping laws on foreign imports.

text.p: China is drafting anti-dumping laws to protect domestic industries from cheap imports, the People's Daily said on Wednesday.
Government officials were exploring how to draft laws and regulations to combat dumping and the use of subsidies by exporters to China, it said, quoting officials at a recent seminar.
The laws would bring China more closely in line with international practices and offer better protection to domestic industry, they said.
Cheap foreign imports and smuggling in recent years had reduced the domestic market shares of some goods, they said. They attributed the problems to China's lack of anti-dumping rules.
China's sugar mills have suffered huge losses because of mass smuggling in recent years and the state has blamed the shrinking of the domestic film industry on cheap foreign products.
